proc
Description
Defines a procedure that can be executed in an event by using the
call
command
Syntax
proc
<
name
>
[
arguments
]
<
script
>
Examples
proc
logme
msg
{
log
local0.
$msg
}
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
call
logme
"Coming to CLIENT_ACCEPTED"
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
call
logme
"Coming to CLIENT_DATA"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
Not valid in events. Must be defined outside the event structure.
Introduced: BIGIP-11.4
